def factor_volume_confirmed_reversal_vol_shock_boost(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret5 = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(5) - 1
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    vol_anomaly = vol_ratio - 1
    base_signal = -ret5 * vol_anomaly
    atr_pct = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"]
    short_mean = atr_pct.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
    long_mean = atr_pct.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    anomaly_atr = short_mean / long_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
    factor_array = np.where(anomaly_atr > 0, base_signal * 1.2, base_signal * 0.8)
    factor = pd.Series(factor_array, index=df_copy.index)
    df_copy["factor_volume_confirmed_reversal_vol_shock_boost"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_volume_confirmed_reversal_vol_shock_boost"]
description: Crossover taking primary parent's volume-confirmed reversal (using adaptive vol_ratio from alpha_tools) and borrowing the volatility-shock amplification idea from the secondary parent. When short-term normalized ATR is elevated relative to its long-term average (anomaly_atr > 0), the base reversal signal is amplified (multiplied by 1.2), otherwise it is slightly attenuated (0.8). This adds a market-state gate without breaking the core reversal-volume mechanism, aiming to improve timing when volatility spikes confirm capitulation. Parent strength target: RankICIR.
